test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'WIFE' is written as '172' and 'CAT' is written as '72'. How will 'SON' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2279c21b248cf244ce9c66a353413ffa1a01afa396a02423895bd343ac1e758.png] 

Logic: **Sum of face value of the letters × Number of letters in the word = Code**

Let's check as per the logic,

**WIFE: 172** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25790e8c64d5440f89dc32330a44a7c0de130146275f066945eeec40f59e9f44.png] **CAT: 72** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31f4db2fdc1fb7aac1b9d17544e11beb81f7af808fdb46f8be6293b55250004d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a209e9203189e8e48dfa65a248c6d7709b48420bbb8a048fc8e70c6afb3b43e8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/543bf378095407cccfb5c575b9d5a060a30251fd4a9d7ca3c9ca97d68ae66e10.png] 

Similarly,

**SON: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/484e263739cebee0e363cda7e4dd50c956b4a90da676b09e53c765075648b7ed.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c64a02a78d3753a85a57c0df4385c2776bc040383399c68aca7449d323b45ea.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"144"**.
